Key Highlights
  • NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 GPU: Powered by NVIDIA Blackwell architecture for modern gaming and creative applications.
  • 8GB GDDR6 Memory: Features 8GB of high-speed GDDR6 video memory with a 128-bit memory interface.
  • Factory Overclocked Performance: Boost clock up to 2632MHz, with an Extreme Performance mode reaching 2647MHz through MSI Center.
  • 2560 CUDA Cores: Delivers GPU processing power for gaming, graphics rendering and supported creative workloads.
  • DLSS 4.5 Support: AI-powered rendering technologies help improve gaming performance and image quality in supported games.
  • Advanced Ray Tracing: Dedicated ray-tracing hardware enables realistic lighting, reflections and shadows in supported titles.
  • TWIN FROZR 10 Cooling: MSI's cooling design helps maintain GPU temperatures during demanding workloads.
  • STORMFORCE Fans: Specially designed fan blades help optimize airflow and cooling performance.
  • ZERO FROZR Technology: Fans stop automatically under low-temperature conditions to reduce noise.
  • Reinforcing Backplate: Strengthens the card and features a ventilation design to help airflow.
  • Multiple Display Support: Three DisplayPort 2.1b outputs and one HDMI 2.1b output support up to four displays.
  • Compact Design: Measures 202 × 120 × 41mm, making it suitable for many gaming PC builds.

Official Warranty Coverage & Claims

This item includes 2 Years Warranty.

Warranty Guidelines & Claims Process
  • How to Claim: To claim a warranty issue, fill out the Return / Warranty Claim Form on our website or get in touch with our customer service team.
  • Distributor & Vendor Processing: Defective or faulty products under warranty are sent to the authorized distributor/vendor for repair, refund, or replacement in accordance with official manufacturer policies.
  • Turnaround Time: Equipment replacement or repair is completed once the official service agent confirms the warranty defect. The warranty process typically takes up to 20 working days to conclude.
  • Eligibility Criteria: Warranty eligibility is applicable solely to products with warranty information mentioned on the product page. Products sold without warranty information are not covered.
  • Rejection Conditions: Warranty claims will be rejected if the product has been physically damaged, burnt, incorrectly installed, opened by unauthorized technicians, or subjected to electrical/liquid abuse.

Refund, Return & Exchange Policy

Fair, customer-first policy backed by dedicated support.

🔄 14-Day Exchange

You can exchange any product purchased from ZahComputers.pk within 14 days of purchase under these conditions:

  • Item is faulty, damaged, or defective upon delivery (applicable for non-COD orders).
  • Item does not match original website specifications or differs from your order.
📹 Unboxing Video & Disputes

To raise a dispute, please notify us within 3 to 4 days of delivery.

Important: For damaged items, providing a continuous unboxing video as evidence is essential. Email the video to support@zahcomputers.pk within 14 days.

📦 Return Window

If a product received does not match the description on our website, you have 7 working days from the delivery date to claim an exchange or cancellation. To qualify, products must be undamaged, unopened, in original retail condition with all packaging materials and accessories intact.

💳 Refund Timelines

When an order is canceled and refund approved, funds are processed within 3 to 4 working days via the original payment channel.

Credit/Debit Cards: May require 7 to 10 additional working days to reflect in your account depending on Pakistani banking security clearance.
